spec.name: Ribbed Ceramic Egg Vase
spec.silhouette: Ovoid egg shape with a flat top opening and flat base
details: Subtle vertical ribbed/fluted texture across the entire surface
Clean, level circular aperture at the top
Soft organic contour tapering toward the top
spec.studio_prompt: An egg-shaped decorative vase measuring 18 cm in diameter and 26 cm in height. The ovoid form features subtle vertical ribs running continuously from the narrow circular top opening down to the base. Crafted entirely from matte, unglazed ceramic with a soft, powdery tactile finish in chalky off-white (#b1a89d) with warm neutral undertones (#948574). Balanced proportions with organic curvature and refined minimalist detailing.
